verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents many per-request parameters (JS rendering, proxies, extract_rules, block_resources) and a CLI `crawl` command. Nothing in the evidence shows a batch job that applies different crawl configurations to different URL patterns. Setting parameters on each request is a developer building block, not the pattern-scoped batch configuration the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
